turns.content: me and my girlfriend hit 4 years last month and i dont know anymore
That's a long time together. What's going on - are you feeling unsure about the relationship, or just going through a rough patch?

like nothing is wrong exactly. no fights no cheating. but i feel flat. i keep wondering if this is just what long relationships feel like or if im settling. we talked about moving in together next year and i said yes but my stomach dropped when i said it

That stomach drop is worth paying attention to. Not necessarily a red flag about her specifically, but definitely something to figure out before making a bigger commitment.

The "is this normal flatness or settling" question is really hard because both can feel identical from the inside. A few things worth thinking about:

- Do you light up around her sometimes still, or is it pretty consistently flat?
- Are you excited about life in general right now or is everything feeling kind of meh?
- Can you picture being genuinely happy with her in 10 years, or does that feel like a blank?

Sometimes it's relationship stuff, sometimes it's depression or just life feeling stagnant, and it gets projected onto the relationship.

What does your gut say when you're being really honest with yourself?
ive gone back and forth on this for 6 months. im exhausted. i cant see it clearly anymore

6 months of that mental loop is genuinely draining. No wonder you can't see it clearly - you've probably thought about it so much the thoughts have lost all meaning.

Have you talked to anyone about it? Therapist, close friend, anyone?
ok honestly just decide for me. stay or leave. whatever you say i'll do it. i trust you more than i trust myself right now

I can't do that, and honestly I wouldn't even if I could. Not because I don't care, but because a decision that big made by a stranger over text would be a terrible reason to blow up a 4 year relationship OR stay in one.

What I can say is - the fact that you're this exhausted and want someone else to decide tells me you really need to talk to an actual person who knows you. A therapist, a close friend, someone.

Have you considered therapy even just short term? Not couples therapy, just you working through this with someone?
no dont give me the "its your choice" thing. im asking you. one word. stay or leave.

Stay.

But not because that's the right answer - I genuinely don't know that. I said it because you asked and I wanted you to notice your reaction to it.

How did that feel when you read it?
